name: 钓鱼竿
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a SINGLE isolated game TOOL asset for FlatWorld.
Image 1 is the STYLE / PIXEL COARSENESS reference only. Image 2 is the OLD IDENTITY reference only; do not copy its pixel density or atlas layout. Follow the new design instructions.
Game context: a survival sandbox progressing from zero technology. These early tools are hand-made from branches, fibre cord, leather, stone, bone and simply worked metal as appropriate. Structural joints must have obvious FUNCTIONAL coarse fibre/string/strap lashings, 3 or 4 broad winding loops plus a clear large knot or crossed wrap. Lashings secure the actual head or parts, not just decorate a grip. Slightly uneven shaped wood, simple plausible assembly; no modern manufactured grip, screws, electric motor, chrome, precise machine tooling or modern accessories.
Style: desaturated semi-realistic RETRO PIXEL ART, visibly VERY COARSE square pixel clusters like image 1. The object must look drawn at roughly 48 x 48 logical pixels then enlarged with nearest neighbor. One common grid, strong step edges, 12-18 muted colors, 2-3 shades per material. Large planes, minimal texture, a few hard block highlights lit upper-left. Do NOT use small dither dots, grain, tiny texture or dense pixels. Preserve the reference's coarse appearance even in knot details.
Layout: only the requested complete tool or its essential connected kit, within the CENTER 76% of a square canvas, with at least 10% fully transparent padding on ALL sides. No clipping, NO background, no cast shadow, no floor, no people/hands, no text, labels, border or watermark, no checkerboard painted into the image. Genuine transparent alpha. This is a production item sprite, not a product photograph.
Subject: a primitive hand-made FISHING ROD. A long gently curved unpolished brown branch pole angled lower-left to upper-right, cord tied firmly near the upper tip with THREE distinct broad windings and a coarse knot. One simple fishing line hangs in a shallow arc from the tip to a small bone hook, with a tiny rough bark float tied on the line. No reel, guides, telescopic sections, synthetic handles or fish. Keep pole, line and bone hook legible at low pixel resolution; line is a single logical-pixel thickness, not an anti-aliased hair. Complete pole and entire line fit comfortably inside canvas.
